decisions.reason: GA4 is the current analytics standard for online shops, so this plugin fits the firm's e-commerce analytics capabilities and still offers upside at relatively low continuation cost.
Because Universal Analytics has effectively been superseded, the product's future value is now largely resolved on the downside and keeping it would tie up resources better used elsewhere.
A retail system interface plugin matches the firm's integration know-how and could deepen client lock-in, so management would likely keep the option open while market demand becomes clearer.
SEO support for shop relaunches is closely aligned with the firm's core full-service offering and likely inexpensive to continue, making it sensible to keep on the market.
